title: Setup Rhino Plugin Debug Configuration
description: Add VSCode debug configuration (tasks.json build task + launch.json dev config) for the compose/3dm Rhino plugin. The setup should use the coreclr debugger, launch Rhino.exe with RHINO_PACKAGE_DIRS pointing to the build output, and use a preLaunchTask to build first. Also add a dev script to the package.json.
summary: Changed TargetFramework to net8.0-windows so Visual Studio uses Managed (CoreCLR) debugger matching Rhino 8 runtime. Updated launchSettings.json plugin path accordingly.
